description: This file defines a Java class 'DefaultHttpClientFacade' that implements the 'HttpClientFacade' interface. It provides a singleton pattern for managing an HTTP client using Akka HTTP, allowing creation of HTTP requests with optional proxy configuration.

classes.name: DefaultHttpClientFacade
classes.description: A singleton class providing HTTP client functionalities utilizing Akka HTTP, with optional proxy settings.

methods.name: getInstance
methods.description: Returns the singleton instance of DefaultHttpClientFacade, initializing it if necessary with provided ActorSystem and HttpProxyConfig.

methods.name: createInstance
methods.description: Creates a new instance of DefaultHttpClientFacade, configuring connection pool settings potentially with proxy settings if enabled.

methods.name: createSingleHttpRequest
methods.description: Creates and sends a single HTTP request asynchronously, returning a CompletionStage of HttpResponse.

methods.name: getActorSystem
methods.description: Returns the ActorSystem associated with this HTTP client facade.
